reason: The CIFs are parseable, primitive P-31c (#163) ordered models that expand to Li6Fe2I12 (20 atoms, Z=2, unit occupancy), and the diffraction evidence is otherwise strong: all important reflections index and the instantiated primary whole-profile fit has Rwp=4.662% with residual MAD about 0.105 versus baseline-noise MAD about 0.101. However, no submitted realization passes the required chemistry check. Complete first shells (with the next I shell beyond 4.0 A) give Fe-I=2.359-2.369 A and Li-I as short as 2.337 A; Brese-O'Keeffe bond-valence sums are Fe +8.28 to +8.56 although charge balance requires Fe3+, I -2.58 to -2.78 rather than I-, and most Li sites are strongly overbonded. This failure affects all three submitted orderings and was missed when the trace treated sixfold coordination alone as validation, so another attempt should seek a materially different heavy-atom realization compatible with the indexed pattern.
